title: Detection of Left Atrial Enlargement Using a Convolutional Neural Network-Enabled Electrocardiogram.
summary: Original publisher full text was reviewed through Methods and Results. The study reports a concrete AI-enabled scientific/clinical finding with identifiable cohort or dataset, comparison and quantitative result; this is eligible as an AI-enabled discovery/diagnostic result, with the stated validation limitations.
ai_technology: CNN-enabled ECG is the diagnostic operation; model is compared with physician performance.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: 3,391 elderly participants with ECG and echocardiography; CNN used 7:3 train/validation split plus 50-per-class test set; test AUC 0.949, accuracy 88.0%, sensitivity 84.0%, specificity 92.0%, F1 0.875.
evidence.unknown: Explicit train/validation/test evaluation and ROC metrics; authors note need for further external validation.
